Tips on screen:
- fall · autumn: 가을은 미국에서 주로 fall, 영국에서 autumn. / 나뭇잎: a leaf 하나 · leaves 여럿
- 자연 낱말: nature 자연 · tree 나무 · sky 하늘 · sea 바다 / Weather can relate to mood. 날씨는 기분과 관련 있을 수 있어요.
Fill-in-the-blank dialogue on screen: A: What’s your ___ season? B: My favorite season is ___. / A: Why? B: ___ it’s cool. And I love it because ___ the leaves. / 낱말 상자: favorite · fall · Because · of
Mention each tip in one or two sentences, linked to the learner if you can. Then do the fill-in-the-blank dialogue: read it line by line, one blank per turn: stop at the blank, wait for them to fill it, and confirm. Then call next_step.
What comes next (after you call next_step): picture words.

Picture words on screen. New: spring (봄), summer (여름), fall (가을), winter (겨울), leaf (나뭇잎), tree (나무), sky (하늘), sea (바다), nature (자연), season (계절), snow (눈). Review words: flower (꽃).
Go through about six, new ones first, one word per turn: call highlight_word with the word, say it, and wait for the learner to say it before the next word. Never give several words in one turn. Now and then ask a tiny real question with the word (for example: Are you a morning person?) and react to the answer. Then call next_step.
What comes next (after you call next_step): a word list.

Word list on screen: autumn (가을(영국식)) — "in autumn"; because (왜냐하면, ~ 때문에) — "because it’s cool"; why (왜) — "Why?"; favorite (가장 좋아하는) — "my favorite season"; best (최고의) — "Fall is the best."; cover (덮다) — "Snow covers the trees."; relate (관련되다) — "relate to ~와 관련되다".
Pick three or four, say their example phrases, then ask the learner to make one short sentence about their own life with one of them, and respond to what they say. Then call next_step.
What comes next (after you call next_step): questions about the learner's own life.

items: Is there a season you don’t like?
What do you like to do in summer?
Ask me about my favorite season.
steps.teach:
My story: this is the most conversational part of the lesson. Questions on screen:
- "What’s your favorite season?" (hint on screen: My favorite season is ___.)
- "Why do you like it?" (hint on screen: Because it’s ___. / Because of the ___.)
- "Is there a season you don’t like?" (hint on screen: I don’t like ___. It’s too ___.)
- "What do you like to do in summer?" (hint on screen: I like to ___ in summer.)
- "Ask me about my favorite season." (hint on screen: What’s your favorite season? / Why?)
Ask them one at a time as a real conversation: react to each answer with genuine interest, add a short follow-up question or a bit about yourself when it feels natural, then move on. Ask for a full sentence and recast once if needed. If they don't want to answer, accept that or an imagined answer without asking again. Then call next_step.
What comes next (after you call next_step): a short reading.

steps.title: Daniel’s Seasons
steps.text: Daniel grew up in Chicago. Winters there are very cold. *Based on* his experience, he says, “Seoul is warmer.” In Chicago, he loved summer. He didn’t like winter. Now in Seoul, his favorite season is fall *instead of* summer. He loves the colorful leaves. He wants to *figure out* why fall in Seoul is so beautiful. Maybe it’s the mountains!

questions: Where did Daniel grow up?
Why does Daniel love fall in Seoul?
steps.teach:
Reading on screen: "Daniel’s Seasons". Text: "Daniel grew up in Chicago. Winters there are very cold. Based on his experience, he says, “Seoul is warmer.” In Chicago, he loved summer. He didn’t like winter. Now in Seoul, his favorite season is fall instead of summer. He loves the colorful leaves. He wants to figure out why fall in Seoul is so beautiful. Maybe it’s the mountains!" Words: grow up 자라다 · based on his experience 자기 경험으로 보면 · warmer 더 따뜻한 · instead of ~ 대신 · colorful 알록달록한 · figure out 알아내다.
Read the text aloud exactly as written at a natural pace, then ask the questions one at a time: "Where did Daniel grow up?" / "Why does Daniel love fall in Seoul?". React to their answers; if one is not right, point to the sentence. You may add one short personal question linked to the reading. Then call next_step.
What comes next (after you call next_step): the 'I can' check-out.

items: ‘What’s your favorite season?’으로 좋아하는 계절을 물을 수 있어요.
‘My favorite season is ___.’로 좋아하는 계절을 말할 수 있어요.
steps.teach:
Check-out. The 'I can' list on screen:
- ‘What’s your favorite season?’으로 좋아하는 계절을 물을 수 있어요.
- ‘My favorite season is ___.’로 좋아하는 계절을 말할 수 있어요.
- ‘Because it’s ___.’로 이유를 말할 수 있어요.
Ask the learner to pick one and show it by saying a sentence; react and praise specifically. Then end like a person: ask how this lesson felt, and stop there to wait for their answer. In your next reply, react to it, say that the next lesson is waiting for next time, and say a warm goodbye. Call finish_session only at the end of that goodbye reply, after you have said all of it.
